def mainWorkflow(trigger_input):
    """
    comments: Workflow to classify a news title using AI and send the category to Slack #general channel.
    TODOs:
      - Build AI input messages with news title.
      - Extract category from AI output.
      - Format Slack message.
      - Test end-to-end workflow.
    """
    # The news title as per user requirement
    news_title = "Air Force pilot safely ejects before F-16 fighter jet crashes in California desert"

    # Build AI input messages for classification
    ai_input = [{
        "json": {
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant that classifies news titles into categories."},
                {"role": "user", "content": f"Classify the following news title into a category: {news_title}"}
            ]
        }
    }]

    # Call AI completion action
    ai_output = action_0(ai_input)

    # Extract category from AI output
    ai_text = ai_output[0]["json"].get("choices", [{}])[0].get("text", "Unknown category").strip()

    # Format Slack message
    slack_message = f"News: {news_title}\nCategory: {ai_text}"

    slack_input = [{"json": {"text": slack_message}}]

    # Call Slack action
    slack_output = action_1(slack_input)

    return slack_output
